outside: clamp mass to nearest endpoint; report signed moment bias and mass
invalid_box: reject nonfinite or nonpositive width/height; no sorting repair
initial: softmax(z0), reference=detach(r0); zero logits in all arms at initialization
C0: fixed detach(r0); softmax(sum of layer logits); no epsilon
C1: detach(previous decoded box); softmax(current logits); no prior probability
M: detach(previous decoded box); softmax(log(T @ previous_probability + epsilon) + current_logits)
coordinate_gradients: none through grids, T, or target encoding; probability and residual paths retained
normalization: input probabilities nonnegative finite and unit mass; no renormalization of T@p; softmax final normalization
probe_selection: sort unique certified train_core IDs by SHA256(UTF8('PR25-probe-v1\0'+canonical_id)), break ties by UTF8 bytes; first128 fit,next64 probe; no other splits
scope: synthetic tensor arithmetic only; no detector, dataset, optimizer, or learning
